## History

Bertha Shirley was Anne's mother, who died of yellow fever when [Anne](../character/anne.md) was only three months old. She was married to [Walter](../character/walter.md) [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), who also succumbed to yellow fever just four days after her death. Their deaths left [Anne](../character/anne.md) an orphan, setting into motion her childhood of being passed between different homes.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

Bertha Shirley was the late mother of [Anne](../character/anne.md), having died when [Anne](../character/anne.md) was just an infant. Though Bertha passed away before [Anne](../character/anne.md) could know her, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her background as a orphaned child to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who feels deep pity for her neglected upbringing. Bertha's early death left [Anne](../character/anne.md) to grow up moving between different homes and eventually an asylum before arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
